title: Regular Expressions for Text
learning_objectives: Write patterns with character classes, quantifiers and anchors
Capture parts of a match with named groups
Compare a regex with the equivalent character loop
entry_point: collapse_spaces_manual(text); collapse_spaces(text); mask_digits(text); find_numbers(text); find_hashtags(text); parse_log(line)
hints: `" ".join(text.split())` collapses whitespace without regex; with regex use `re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()`.
Numbers: `r"-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?"`; hashtags: `r"(?<!\w)#(\w+)"` (a negative look-behind for 'not preceded by a word character').

failure_feedback.advice: Use a non-capturing group for the decimal part so findall returns whole numbers.
Require that `#` is not preceded by a word character, and lowercase the result.
Use `fullmatch` so the whole line must match, and list only the four levels.
The message group should be `.+` and must not be cleaned.
